info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with Photon Realtime
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with Photon Realtime

elements.name: realtime.init
elements.description: Initialize Realtime by creating a load balanced client

elements.name: realtime.connect
elements.description: Connect to the server. - username - use_datagram_encryption - server_type See SERVER_TYPE_* enums - server_address The IP address or domain name and optionally the port number to connect to. IP addresses can be in IPv4 or IPv6 format - auth_data Sets the HTTP POST data, that will be forwarded to the authentication service, to the provided data. - auth_parameters The HTTP GET parameters that will be forwarded to the authentication service to the provided parameters. - auth_type The type of the "Custom Authentication" service that will be used. See AUTH_* enums

elements.name: realtime.update
elements.description: Update Realtime. Call this from a script component.

elements.name: realtime.create_room
elements.description: Create room. Local game_id = "1234" local room_options = { is_visible = false, is_open = false, supress_room_events = false, max_players = 4, player_ttl = 0, empty_room_ttl = 0, lobby_type = realtime.LOBBYTYPE_DEFAULT, lobby_name = "", publish_user_id = "", direct_mode = realtime.DIRECTMODE_NONE, props_listed_in_lobby = {}, custom_room_properties = {}, } local expected_users = {} realtime.create_room(game_id, room_options, expected_users)

parameters.name: game_id
parameters.doc: The name to create a room with. Must be unique and not in use or the room can't be created. If this is an empty string, then the server will assign a GUID as name.

parameters.name: game_id

elements.name: realtime.set_auto_join_lobby
elements.description: Set the auto join lobby flag. The value of the autoJoinLobby flag determines if the client will automatically join the default lobby whenever it has successfully connected and whenever it leaves a game room.

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_STEAM
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Steam Account. Pass L"ticket=[ticket]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Steam Account. Pass L"ticket=[ticket]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_FACEBOOK
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Facebook Account. Pass L"token=[token]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Facebook Account. Pass L"token=[token]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_OCULUS
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Oculus Account. Pass L"userid=[userid]&nonce=[nonce]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Oculus Account. Pass L"userid=[userid]&nonce=[nonce]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_PLAYSTATION_4
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their PSN Account. Pass L"token=[token]&env=[env]&userName=[userName]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their PSN Account. Pass L"token=[token]&env=[env]&userName=[userName]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_XBOX
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their XBox Network Account. Pass the XSTS token to setData().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their XBox Network Account. Pass the XSTS token to setData().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_VIVEPORT
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their HTC Viveport Account and user token. Pass L"userToken=[userToken]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their HTC Viveport Account and user token. Pass L"userToken=[userToken]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_NINTENDO_SWITCH
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Nintendo Account. Pass L"token=[token]&appversion=[appversion]" to setParameters(). The appversion is optional.
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Nintendo Account. Pass L"token=[token]&appversion=[appversion]" to setParameters(). The appversion is optional.

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_PLAYSTATION_5
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their PSN Account. Pass L"token=[token]&env=[env]&userName=[userName]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their PSN Account. Pass L"token=[token]&env=[env]&userName=[userName]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_EPIC
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Epic Online Services (EOS) Account. Pass L"token=[token]&ownershipToken=[ownershipToken]" to setParameters(). The ownershipToken is optional.
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Epic Online Services (EOS) Account. Pass L"token=[token]&ownershipToken=[ownershipToken]" to setParameters(). The ownershipToken is optional.

elements.name: realtime.AUTH_FACEBOOK_GAMING
elements.brief: Authenticates users by their Facebook Account. Pass L"token=[token]" to setParameters().
elements.description: Authenticates users by their Facebook Account. Pass L"token=[token]" to setParameters().

elements.name: realtime.SERVER_TYPE_NAME_SERVER
elements.brief: Photon Cloud and for self-hosted Photon 5 or higher Server instances
elements.description: Photon Cloud and for self-hosted Photon 5 or higher Server instances

elements.name: realtime.MATCHMAKINGMODE_FILL_ROOM
elements.brief: Fills up rooms (oldest first) to get players together as fast as possible. Default. Makes most sense with MaxPlayers > 0 and games that can only start with more players.
elements.description: Fills up rooms (oldest first) to get players together as fast as possible. Default. Makes most sense with MaxPlayers > 0 and games that can only start with more players.

elements.name: realtime.MATCHMAKINGMODE_SERIAL_MATCHING
elements.brief: Distributes players across available rooms sequentially but takes filters into account. Without filters, rooms get players evenly distributed.
elements.description: Distributes players across available rooms sequentially but takes filters into account. Without filters, rooms get players evenly distributed.

elements.name: realtime.MATCHMAKINGMODE_RANDOM_MATCHING
elements.brief: Joins a (fully) random room. Expected properties must match, but aside from this, any available room might be selected.
elements.description: Joins a (fully) random room. Expected properties must match, but aside from this, any available room might be selected.

elements.name: realtime.LOBBYTYPE_DEFAULT
elements.brief: This lobby type is used unless another lobby type is specified. Room lists will be sent and Client::opJoinRandomRoom() can filter by matching properties.
elements.description: This lobby type is used unless another lobby type is specified. Room lists will be sent and Client::opJoinRandomRoom() can filter by matching properties.

elements.name: realtime.LOBBYTYPE_SQL_LOBBY
elements.brief: This lobby type lists rooms like type DEFAULT but  SQL-like "where" clauses for filtering can be used with Client::opJoinRandomRoom(). This allows 'bigger', 'less', 'or' and 'and' combinations.
elements.description: This lobby type lists rooms like type DEFAULT but  SQL-like "where" clauses for filtering can be used with Client::opJoinRandomRoom(). This allows 'bigger', 'less', 'or' and 'and' combinations.

elements.name: realtime.LOBBYTYPE_ASYNC_RANDOM_LOBBY
elements.brief: This lobby does not send room lists. It is only used for Client::opJoinRandomRoom(). It keeps rooms available for matchmaking for a while even when there are only inactive users left.
elements.description: This lobby does not send room lists. It is only used for Client::opJoinRandomRoom(). It keeps rooms available for matchmaking for a while even when there are only inactive users left.

elements.name: realtime.DIRECTMODE_NONE
elements.brief: Do not create any 2p2 connections between the clients. This is the default.
elements.description: Do not create any 2p2 connections between the clients. This is the default.

elements.name: realtime.DIRECTMODE_ALL_TO_OTHERS
elements.brief: Each client establishes a direct connection with every other client inside the room.
elements.description: Each client establishes a direct connection with every other client inside the room.

elements.name: realtime.DIRECTMODE_MASTER_TO_OTHERS
elements.brief: The master client establishes a direct connection with every other client inside the room. All other clients only establish a direct connection with the master client but not with each other.
elements.description: The master client establishes a direct connection with every other client inside the room. All other clients only establish a direct connection with the master client but not with each other.

elements.name: realtime.DIRECTMODE_ALL_TO_ALL
elements.brief: Each client establishes a direct connection with every client inside the room, including itself.
elements.description: Each client establishes a direct connection with every client inside the room, including itself.

elements.name: realtime.DIRECTMODE_MASTER_TO_ALL
elements.brief: The master client establishes a direct connection with every client inside the room, including itself. All other clients only establish a direct connection with the master client but not with each other.
elements.description: The master client establishes a direct connection with every client inside the room, including itself. All other clients only establish a direct connection with the master client but not with each other.
